clips.title: The story
paras: Tradesmen's Terrace gathers Darnassus's merchants and craftspeople along the city's southern edge. Its auction house and shops connect travelers with goods from Teldrassil and beyond.

Tradesmen's Terrace fills the southern stretch of Darnassus with shops and merchants. Here, kaldorei and travelers from the wider Alliance find provisions, crafting supplies, and the city's central auction house. Paths lead north to the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the Temple of the Moon. For journeys into the wilds, this is where travelers gather what they need.

Kaldorei shops favor quiet stone, timber, and woven goods, shaped to live in harmony with nature. The terrace has none of the roaring furnaces or smog found in dwarven and human workshops. Adventurers seeking trade contracts, repairs, or materials gathered from Teldrassil's boughs find the principal center of business in northern Kalimdor here.
